# 18: Viewed session 的唯一 Marker area

**What to build:** 进程唯一 Marker area 跟随实际查看目标的有效 State，查看只改变展示而不扩大 Owner 权限。

**Delivers:** P27

**Blocked by:** 01: 公开 Viewed session 并冻结隔离宿主；02: 公共工厂生命周期与 actions 路由

**Status:** ready-for-agent

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] 沿公共 Viewed session 出口投影目标有效 State，follow 读取 Owner 当前值，none 使用声明默认，不复制主全部 marker。
- [ ] 查看/目标失效不改变 Owner、继承或写权限，子事件不获得主会话外部效果权限。
- [ ] 重复模块图仍共享进程唯一 Marker area，位置/行序/widget 身份由 framework 拥有，不新建扩展专属或第二 marker 区。
- [ ] 通过公共事实与实际 UI marker 结果验证主/子切换、follow/none、不可写及进程唯一性，不用内部 StateStore dump。
- [ ] 准备 P27 H1 的 State 场景、期望标记、切换步骤及自动结果；真实视觉仍待人工确认。
- [ ] 通过批准的生产公共 seam 观察行为，预期来自合同/规格、独立字面值或手算，不以被测实现重算；永久网络 tests 使用 mock。
- [ ] 使用隔离安装/配置/工作/Session/数据根，不操作正式 OMP；承接异步失败并保留够用脱敏证据，完成本票自动检查及材料准备，不因计划人工验收暂停可执行工作。

tdd_result.description: Implement unique marker area for viewed sessions

behavior_delivered.summary: The framework's one process-global Marker area now projects the *displayed* session's own effective State instead of the State of whichever session's delivery published last, and viewing changes the rendering only.
framework: framework/core/protocol.ts: new HarnessPort.viewedSession?: ViewedSessionPort (adapter-facing read+notify pair: read(): OwnerReference | undefined, subscribe(listener(markers)): () => void). undefined = harness publishes no outlet (delivery-position fallback preserved); resolved unresolved = outlet exists but the target's owner is unobtainable (area is honestly emptied, never another session's lines).

framework/behaviors/marker.ts: MarkerEntry reads via stateValueFor (existing per-field inheritance rule) against a *seat*; MarkerSeat = (own) => viewed.read() ?? own; publishMarkerArea / publishMarkerOnViewChange (view-change publication, quiet when this binding's line is absent unless the seat carries no line at all, which must clear the widget); publishMarkerOnRun/publishMarkerOnTransition now take the seat.

framework/behaviors/{binding,session-events,control}.ts: the seat is resolved per binding and threaded through run initiations, State reconciles, capability writes and both command write paths; the binding subscribes once when the definition declares a marker and releases the listener on the teardown branch (delivering=false).

framework/adapters/omp.ts: OmpSessionContext gets optional getViewedSession()/subscribeViewedSessionChanged() and OmpViewedSessionFacts (identity/kind/parent of the displayed session); facts resolve to the same OwnerReference as a delivery (main=owner, sub=registry walk to nearest main; display name never an identity; unobtainable fact => unresolved). The port re-points its native subscription per session context and drops it when the last framework listener goes; a host without the outlet answers read()=undefined.
public_contract_migration: extensions/model-cost/harnesses/omp/widget.ts: its local outlet facts type now extends the adapter's exported OmpViewedSessionFacts and its ctx type extends OmpSessionContext (the adapter now names the outlet members), removing the duplicate declaration.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: AC1 follow/none effective projection along the public Viewed session outlet; no copy of main's whole marker set
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tests/framework/viewed-marker.test.ts (a displayed subagent renders [◈ follow] only: follow reads the Owner's current value, none the declared default; returning to the Owner restores both lines; a later Owner write moves what the sub view shows, so it is a live read not a switch-time copy). tests/framework/marker-module-duplication.test.ts: new case — either duplicated module-graph copy projects the same subagent seat.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: AC2 viewing/target invalidation changes no Owner, inheritance or write authority; subagent events acquire no main-session effect authority
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tests/framework/viewed-marker.test.ts: a subagent's own commands record and publish nothing (persistence identical before/after), the Owner's value survives a subagent boundary and a view switch, and the projection is read-only by construction (ViewedSessionPort has no write member).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: AC3 one process-global Marker area, framework-owned placement/line order/widget identity, no per-extension or second area
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tests/framework/marker-module-duplication.test.ts (one area across duplicated module copies, extended to the viewed seat) and tests/framework/viewed-marker.test.ts (every rendering under the one key/placement); dock run asserts no fixture-named widget key is ever used.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: AC4 verified through public facts and actual UI marker results (main/sub switch, follow/none, non-writability, process uniqueness), no internal StateStore dump
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Framework seam: ompAdapter + a native double that publishes the host outlet (ctx.getViewedSession/subscribeViewedSessionChanged) — 7 tests, all green. Real host: tests/harness-dock/viewed-marker.test.ts on the frozen patched artifact (RPC + real task-tool spawned session) reads the host's own setWidget frames.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: AC5 P27 H1 State scenario, expected markers, switch steps and automatic results prepared; real visual still human
acceptance_criteria.evidence: .scratch/model-cost-migration/assets/18-viewed-state-marker-evidence-2026-10-13.md sections 'P27 H1 材料' (5-step interactive scenario, expected lines per step, isolated launch steps) and the unresolved observation below; no pass is claimed for H1.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: AC6 approved production public seams; expectations from contract/spec/independent literals, never recomputed by the tested implementation; permanent network tests mocked
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Seams S1 (framework public binding/facts) and S5 (isolated host operator entry); all expected marker lines are hand-written literals ([◈ follow, ◐ none] / [◈ follow] / cleared); no test reaches the network — the dock run answers through the dock's local capture endpoint.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: AC7 isolated install/config/work/session/data roots; no formal OMP touched; async failures carried and evidence redacted
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Dock run uses ensureViewedSessionHarness() (frozen patched prefix) + createRunRoot (agent-state/sessions/work/capture inside the run root); no credential is used or printed (capture endpoint only). One genuinely unexplained observation is recorded rather than smoothed over (below).

verification_commands.result: 1 pass / 0 fail (2.6s: frozen patched host, RPC, real task-tool subagent, host's own setWidget frames)

548 pass / 2 fail — PRE-EXISTING, not mine: connect-bot/budget-regression.test.ts:438 (real omp-bot panel emits 2 extra upserts) and panel-registration-lifecycle.test.ts:186 (30s panel window observed as 15s). Both failures are byte-identical in .cache/full-suite-13.log (11:44) and .cache/full-suite.log (05:53), recorded before this ticket's edits (13:57); the same logs also fail harness-dock/baseline.ts on the checkout anchor, i.e. environment/artifact drift (real panel binary + moved oh-my-pi checkout), not a regression from the marker projection.

unresolved_or_unverified: Real-host subagent rendering (S5) is only partly established: on the real RPC host the Owner's session renders both lines under the framework's one widget key/placement (asserted, green), but inside the delegating prompt's window the spawned session's own publication was observed *clearing* the area (frame sequence [OWNER..., undefined...]); its [◈ followMarker]-only rendering appears only later (the spawned session's own late fact-change notifications). The framework seam rules out a projection mistake (the same facts project correctly on the double), so this is recorded as unexplained rather than passed. Unresolved candidates: (a) that RPC child's outlet facts resolving to unresolved, (b) that publication having no projectable cell at that instant. Next step suggested in the evidence: a fixture-level outlet probe printing each ctx's getViewedSession()/resolution.

P27 H1 (real interactive focus switch: main→sub→main, follow/none lines, invalidation fallback) is prepared but not run; it remains unverified until the user confirms it. The dock run cannot cover it: an RPC host reports each session's own facts rather than a separate viewed session.

The dock test therefore asserts only what the host showed (Owner rendering, one widget identity/placement, no extension-named widget key); the subagent-render assertion was deliberately not kept, so no criterion is weakened and none is claimed green on this evidence.
Pre-existing environment failures (2 connect-bot panel tests + 2 harness-dock baseline anchor tests) are outside this ticket and untouched.
